notes: Governing documents: APM 760, 715, 710, 133, 700 (UC system-wide, in force on the reference date) and the UCR Work/Life Balance Initiative memorandum and procedures (campus policy, revised Sept 2015). Summaries: HR pages 2018_04/05 (Dec/Feb 2017), the APO leave table (2011), the leave guidelines (2015) and the CHAIR 201 presentation (dated 2018-03-02, two days after the reference date). 2018_03 is a navigation page with no policy.

Campus and system both coded (V3c): the UCR two paid quarters for birth mothers (c3 leave quarter within c4) linked concurrent_with APM 760-28 ASMD (c5); the UCR paid quarter for non-childbearing faculty (c6, discretionary) in_lieu_of c5's ASMD quarter.

Entitlement wording differs among the campus documents: memo 'will automatically ... be approved' (birth) and 'may be granted' (non-birth); guidelines 'may be granted' (birth); HR page 'UCR policy provides'; leave table 'eligible'. The memo governs (source precedence); flagged on c3, c4, c6.
Calendar: quarters, length not stated; calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. APM lengths given 'two quarters (or two semesters)' coded in quarters.

U8 paths: a birth mother with less than one full academic year of full-time service gets one quarter in total (APM 760-28-a); paid medical leave is 3 quarters after 10 years (duration_max). Non-Senate academic appointees' childbearing pay (c18) and HSCP faculty ASMD (c28) are other groups. Sick-leave accrual (c16) is for non-faculty titles; vacation accrual (c17) for fiscal-year appointees.

Job reinstatement after childbearing or parental leave (APM 760-35-e) and continued health coverage during FML are features of the leaves, not separate components. UCR teaching-replacement funds go to the department (2018_05), not to the parent; not a component. Disability reasonable accommodation (APM 711, 710-28) is not a component (checklist §1).

Cited but not saved: APM 758 (Other Leaves with Pay); APM 759 (Other Leaves Without Pay); APM 711; APM 730 (Vacation); APM 740; APM 110-15; APM 220; APM 025; UC Short-Term Disability and Supplemental Disability Insurance Plans; UCR HSCP implementing procedures (2015, Oct 2014); the Provost's memo of June 22, 2015 on funding; Academic MOUs for represented appointees; UCR Lactation Program page; FAQ for Family Friendly Policies; Paid Leave Checklist; FML Fact Sheet; Delegation of Authority chart.

Birth-parent chain: UCR childbearing leave 1 quarter with pay (c3) [PDL c1 alongside, up to 4 months, with APM 6-week pay c2 within c1; FMLA c8 alongside c1] -> ASMD quarter (c4 two-quarter total containing c3, concurrent with APM ASMD c5); if medically needed, paid medical leave c11 (pay c12 within) after c3 -> unpaid medical leave c13; CFRA c9 after PDL c1, with unpaid parental leave c7 alongside CFRA; all within the one-year aggregate limit.

Non-birth-parent chain: ASMD 1 quarter at full salary (c5) or, in lieu, UCR paid parental leave 1 quarter (c6, discretionary) within unpaid parental leave up to 1 year (c7); FMLA c8 and CFRA c9 alongside c7; discretionary paid FML c10 within c8.
